description: Turn OpenClaw into a social media manager for Fuxux: schedule and publish to 14 platforms (X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky, Threads, Pinterest, Discord, Kick, Twitch, Telegram, Slack) via REST API and MCP, with drafts, queue, editing, analytics and AI captions.
